title: Underground Wires, Tax Breaks, Alley Fights
summary:
*   **Underground Utilities Approved:** The council authorized the Southwestern Telegraph & Telephone Co. to construct underground conduits for their lines across Austin's streets, alleys, and public grounds.
*   **Property Tax Clarity:** Resolved a specific tax lien issue, allowing a new homeowner (Mrs. E. J. Clark) to pay only the property tax on her lot, separating it from the previous owner's unpaid personal property tax, which could not attach to the homestead.
*   **Tax Penalty Relief:** A 5% penalty for late tax payment was waived for a citizen (David Harrell) whose check was delayed by the Post Office, demonstrating flexibility in unforeseen circumstances.
*   **Alley Access Debate:** The council rejected a proposal to repeal an earlier ordinance that allowed the Austin Gas Light Co. to close an alley, maintaining the utility's access to that space.

• Regular meeting of the City Council : Austin,Texas, June 1st1911.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor : Roll called : Present Mayor
Wooldridge,Councilmen Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell Absent none.
The minutes of the last regular and subsequent recessed meeting were read and approved.
Councilman Hart to whom was referred petitions from Citizens ,asking to have the Pound
limits extended ,stated that as yet he was not prepared to report.

Unfinished business :

Dufstroller
Conduits
The Mayor laid before the Council an ordinance authorizingthe South Western Telegraph &
Telephone Co to construct underground conduits throug across,along and under certain
streets ,alleys and public grounds of the City of Austin,etc,which had been read the third
time.
The ordinance was then passed by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell 5 Nays none.

New business:
Yates. A C McMillan
Mrs E J Clark.
Councilman Lockridge offered the following resolution : Whereas, C A McMillan ,claiming to
be the owner of Lot 2 Block 5,in the Driskill & Rainey Sub Division of a part of Out Lots
72 & 73 Div "E"in the City of Austin,assessed said lot and improvements for the year
1910,at $ 1125.00 ,and at the same time assessed personal property owned by him at $
1130.00,and, Whereas, said McMillan at the time of said Assessment was owing the purchase
money on said lot and has since conveyed said lot to Mrs E J Clark,in consideration of the
cancellation of his purchase money notes and, Whereas, said McMillan failed to pay the
1910 taxes on saidlot and also failed to pay the taxes on said personal property,and,
Whereas, said Mrs E J Clark,desires to pay the real estate tax and have said lot released
as to the lien thereon by virtue of said person-al tax and Whereas, at the time of the
1910 assessment said lotwas the homestead of said McMillan ,and as such was liable only
for the taxes thereon: Now Therefore : Be it resolved by the City Council of the City
ofAustin: That the Assessor & collector of said City be and he is hereby instruct-ed to
receive from the said Mrs E J Clark the taxes for 1910,assessed against said lot and
improvements and issue to her a receipt in FULL for all taxes of 1910,assessed against
said lot and improvements.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell 5 Nays none.
The Council then recessed until 3 P M this day.

Austin,Friday June 2nd 1911.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor with all members present.

Mrs N W Holden
leave absence The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it resolved
by the City Council or the City of Austin : That a leave of absence be and the same is
hereby granted to Mrs Nellie W Holden, Secretary of the United Charities Association,for
the month of June ,1911.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell 5 Nays none.

Application for
refunded to
Jno Hottinger - The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : Be it
resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin : That for sufficient reasons thereunto
moving,the City Council hereby refunds to Jno G Hottinger two dollars ( $ 2.00) ,paid by
him as license to be foot pedlar for theyear beginning Dec9,1910,and the City Clerk of the
City of Austin is here authorized and instructed to draw warrent for said $ 2.00 ,and
charge the same to the general contingent fund of the City of Austin.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lockridge & Powell 5 Nays none.

The Council then recessed subject to call of the Mayor .

Saturday June 3rd 1911.
The Council was called to order by the Mayor with all members present.

David Harrell
Penalty on taxes
remitted The Mayor laid before the Council the following resolution : It appeared to the
satisfaction of the City Council that Mr David Harrell had, on May 31,1911, mailed his
certain check to Fred Sterzing,Collector,in payment of taxes owing by himself and certain
other persons represented by him to the City of Austin,Texas,which check was not promptly
delivered through the Post Office department to the City Assessor and Collector on or
before June 1st,1911,therefore Be it resolved by the City Council of the City of Austin :
That the penalty of five per cent imposed against taxpayers who fail to pay their taxes on
or before June 1st of each year,be and the same in this instance is hereby remitted.
Be it further resolved :
That a copy of this resolution be furnished by the City Clerk to the City Assessor &
Collector.
The resolution was adopted by the following vote : Yeas Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen
Bartholomew,Hart,Lookridge & Powell 5 Nays none.
Austin Gas Co to By Councilman Lockridge an ordinance to repeal an ordinance authorizing

the South half of Out Lot 2 Division "O",in the City of Austin,Texas,which ordinance was
approved March 10,1910.
The ordinance was read the first time and a vote taken on same ,which vote result -ed as
follows:
Yeas Councilman Lockridge 1

Nays Mayor Wooldridge,Councilmen Bartholomew,Hart & Powell 4
